subjects.name: Architecture-Overview
subjects.description: Solution layout, the two packages, layering, dependencies and the end-to-end resolution flow
subjects.prompt: Explain the overall architecture: the two NuGet packages, the ISecretResolver seam, how the IConfigurationBuilder extension orchestrates resolution, the netstandard2.0 target and the dependency set.

subjects.name: Secret-Resolution-Pipeline
subjects.description: The configuration-build-time pipeline: discovery, deduplication, bounded-concurrency fetch, substitution and fail-closed behaviour
subjects.prompt: Document the resolution pipeline stage by stage, the temp-configuration probe and its disposal, URI deduplication, the SemaphoreSlim gate, the OverallTimeout budget, reference substitution and the fail-closed null contract. Contrast the Azure and HashiCorp implementations.

subjects.name: Security-Model
subjects.description: Threat model and the defences: fail-closed resolution, host and address allowlisting, secret masking, credential-chain hardening, ReDoS bounds and transport rules
subjects.prompt: Document the threat model and every control: fail-closed resolution, vault host suffix allowlist, Vault address pinning, secret-URI masking in logs and exception properties, DefaultAzureCredential hardening, Azure SDK content logging suppression, regex timeouts, path/key validation and HTTPS enforcement. State explicitly what the library does not protect against.

subjects.name: Reference-Formats
subjects.description: The four supported reference syntaxes, embedded and multiple references in one value, and the parsing rules that constrain them
subjects.prompt: Document every reference format with the exact regex constraints, how VaultName references become URIs via VaultDnsSuffix, embedded/multi-reference substitution, and the public IsKeyVaultReference / ExtractSecretUri / ExtractSecretInfo helpers.

subjects.name: Azure-Key-Vault-Provider
subjects.description: KeyVaultSecretResolver: URI parsing, SecretClient reuse, credential construction, timeouts and error mapping
subjects.prompt: Document the Azure Key Vault resolver: secret URI parsing and validation, per-vault SecretClient caching, DefaultAzureCredential construction from options, per-secret timeout, RequestFailedException status mapping to actionable messages, and disposal semantics.

subjects.name: HashiCorp-Vault-Provider
subjects.description: HashiCorpVaultSecretResolver: reference parsing, mount/path splitting, KV v1 vs v2 probing, re-authentication and address trust
subjects.prompt: Document the HashiCorp Vault resolver: mount path splitting, KV v2-then-v1 probing and why sys/mounts is not read, the single re-authentication retry on 401/403, VaultSharp's lack of CancellationToken support and the VaultServiceTimeout workaround, Vault namespaces, and trusted-address resolution.

subjects.name: Vault-Authentication-Methods
subjects.description: HashiCorp auth methods (Token, AppRole, Kubernetes) with auto-detection order, and the Azure credential chain
subjects.prompt: Document IVaultAuthMethod and its three implementations, the environment-variable auto-detection order and its hazards, Kubernetes projected-token re-reading, and the Azure-side DefaultAzureCredential exclusions.

subjects.name: Secret-Caching-And-Rotation
subjects.description: The in-memory cache, TTL semantics, forceRefresh, InvalidateCache, and why IConfiguration values do not change after startup
subjects.prompt: Document the CacheEntry design, the infinite default TTL and its rationale, on-demand refresh patterns, and the hard boundary between resolver cache and already-materialised IConfiguration values.

subjects.name: Secret-Validity-Enforcement
subjects.description: NotBefore and ExpiresOn handling: warnings, the expiry warning threshold and optional hard rejection
subjects.prompt: Document why Key Vault secret expiry is advisory, how CheckValidityPeriod enforces it at the consumer, the ExpiryWarningThreshold, RejectSecretsOutsideValidityPeriod, and the compliance angle (CIS expiration controls).

subjects.name: Configuration-Reference
subjects.description: Every option on both option classes, defaults, validation rules and the environment variables that are read
subjects.prompt: Produce a complete option-by-option reference for both packages with type, default, effect and recommended production value, plus Validate() rules and all environment variables consumed.

subjects.name: Environment-Deployment-Guide
subjects.description: Per-host deployment recipes: App Service, Functions, AKS, containers, local development and sovereign clouds
subjects.prompt: Give prerequisites and a concrete recommended option set per hosting environment, the required vault permissions, sovereign-cloud configuration, and the minimum HashiCorp Vault policy.

subjects.name: Logging-And-Monitoring
subjects.description: Event IDs, log levels, what each record contains, and the log-based controls worth alerting on
subjects.prompt: Document every EventId with its level, message template and structured fields, the deliberate level split that keeps secret names out of aggregated stores, and suggested alert rules and dashboards.

subjects.name: Troubleshooting-Guide
subjects.description: Symptom-to-cause table for every failure the library raises, with the exception types and remedies
subjects.prompt: Build a symptom-to-cause runbook: every exception message and status mapping, null configuration values, timeouts, throttling, auth auto-detection surprises, KV version mismatches and host/address rejections.

subjects.name: Local-Setup-And-Testing
subjects.description: Building the solution, running the xunit.v3 suites, and the testing conventions including MockSecretResolver
subjects.prompt: Document the SDK floor and why, build/test commands, the xunit.v3 + Microsoft.Testing.Platform setup, the VaultEnvironment non-parallel collection, MockSecretResolver usage and its production hazards.

subjects.name: Release-And-Publishing
subjects.description: CI workflows, dependency auditing, version lockstep and NuGet Trusted Publishing
subjects.prompt: Document the CI, CodeQL and release pipelines, SHA-pinned actions, the vulnerable-dependency gate, the tag/version check, OIDC Trusted Publishing, and the requirement that both package versions move together.
